t.p: Discover luxury through the magic of an exceptional fragrance, carefully crafted from the finest and rarest oils in the world, designed to embrace your uniqueness.

In the first phase, from the very first minute, the fragrance opens with the richness of saffron blended with raspberry and thyme. From minute 16 up to 3 hours, it reveals the luxurious notes of patchouli combined with jasmine and frankincense. Finally, from 3 hours to 10 hours after application, the scent settles into warm amber, leather, and the deep essence of Indian woods.
We designed this olfactory journey especially for you—because you truly deserve it.
